concerns.text: FR-008 mandates validation against a 'null model of phase-shuffled time series'. Task T024 implements 'AR-based surrogate null models' and explicitly rejects phase-shuffling. While the plan argues this is scientifically superior, the task does not cover the specific requirement in FR-008. A task covering the phase-shuffled validation (or a task explicitly documenting the requirement override) is missing.

SC-001 requires measuring the proportion of subjects 'successfully processed' (implying end-to-end success). Task T015a calculates this metric after US1 (ingestion) and motion exclusion, but before US2 (metric computation) and US3 (regression). There is no task to calculate the final success rate after the full pipeline completes, leaving SC-001 partially unmet.

FR-001 requires downloading data from the 'specified source'. Task T012 lists the URL as 's://hcp-openaccess/HCP_1200_Subjects/', which is syntactically invalid (missing protocol). The task cannot be executed as written to satisfy FR-001's integrity check requirement.

FR-006 and SC-003 reference a '10,000-permutation test'. Task T031 describes implementing a permutation test with 'a sufficient number of iterations' but lacks a specific task to enforce or configure the 10,000 iteration count required by the spec's success criteria.

Task T015a is named 'Calculate and report success rate (SC-001)' but is placed in Phase 3 (US1). The logic described reads 'exclusion_log.csv' which is generated in US1, but the 'Total_Subjects' count and final 'Pro_Processed' metric for SC-001 should reflect the entire pipeline. The task description conflates US1 success with the global SC-001 metric, creating ambiguity in coverage.
